entities.summary: The Gwangyang Football Stadium, a.k.a. the Dragon Dungeon, is a football-specific stadium in Gwangyang, South Korea. It is currently used mostly for football matches and is the home stadium of the Jeonnam Dragons. The stadium holds 13,496 spectators. It was built in 1992 and opened in 1993.
